answer: PoA already charges a mined admission proof per identity, but a one-time proof is only a speed bump - a farm re-mines it in parallel. Bind each identity to attested hardware: the key lives in a TEE, and every epoch the enclave returns a quote binding its measurement, the address and a fresh nonce, so no quote lifts to a second address. A thousand clones need a thousand attested devices and fresh quotes each epoch, and vendor-signed enclave supply is inelastic, so the hundredth head costs more than the first. Each head is a lotus alone in the ocean; no comet tail transfers.
